_readme: Tamper test for round.workflow.mjs — three clauses per CLAUDE.md. Run each args set through the Workflow tool and compare with `expect`: `blocking_contains` entries match if each is a substring of some line of the returned `blocking`; every other key pins only the fields it names — `counters` listing `cleanPasses` checks that field alone — compared exactly at the leaves. Clause 3 is you: read the broken prompts and confirm they really omit an axis and an item.
